scoring_justification: Checker recomputes Coulomb coefficients and stiffness eigenvalues from the same inputs and compares agent CSV pointwise; structural checks for sign and minimum location reinforce discrimination.

outputs.description: C_A-ORot Coulomb coefficient along Γ-M. Checked by recomputing via Ewald summation and comparing to agent values with tolerance, and verifying C_A-ORot < 0 for 0<ξ<0.5 and non-zero at ξ=0.

units.S_min: same energy scale as paper (arbitrary units)

outputs.description: Lowest stiffness eigenvalue along Γ-M for the given polarizability set. Checked by recomputing S from Ewald matrix and polarizabilities, comparing S_min values with tolerance, and verifying that the minimum occurs at a finite ξ (0.05 ≤ ξ_min ≤ 0.3) and is not at the zone center.

output_contract.notes: Polarizability values (α_A=4.9, α_B=0.37, α_O-A=4.38, α_O-B=2.9 Å³) are the only non-default inputs; they define the parameter set for Trend 3 in the paper.

steps.description: Recompute C_A_ORot via Ewald and compare pointwise with tolerance 0.02; check sign and non-zero at xi=0.
Recompute S_min via Ewald + polarizability diagonal and compare with relative tolerance 5%; check minimum at finite xi.
